FEATURE / STORY / CUTSCENE ISSUE: Extend the Kentridge playable slice with the original early-game Awon and Medrare story sequence from jlashmet/mounting-force. This is a fidelity port, not a rewrite. Before implementation, inspect both the imported References/MountingForce story/contracts and the original mounting-force event implementations. Use the original dialogue verbatim and preserve the meaningful cutscene choreography: actor starting locations, facing, movement order, walk destinations, pauses, entrances/exits, player-control locking, transitions, prerequisites, completion flags, and revisit behavior.

The current imported opening contract already establishes that after the Logan opening Weldon needs to stop by his father Awon at the southwest Kentridge house north of the church. The source progression also contains distinct Awon/Medrare events including kentridge-awon, medrare-to-church, and medrare-first-spell. Trace the authoritative source sequence and include every event that belongs in this early Kentridge slice; do not collapse it into two generic NPC conversations or stop midway through an immediately connected original sequence.

ARCHITECTURE BOUNDARY: Translate legacy coordinates into semantic staging anchors appropriate to the rebuilt Kentridge, but do not redesign the blocking. Author scene-specific identities, triggers, spawn/staging anchors, dialogue, and scenario parameters through the existing Kentridge/Game cutscene and story composition paths. If an original cue requires a capability the current reusable cutscene/runtime APIs do not expose (for example NPC walk-to, face actor, wait, follow, conditional progression, room transition, or control lock), add the missing generic primitive to the shared game/cutscene system rather than hard-coding a Kentridge-only workaround.

ACCEPTANCE: (1) fresh Kentridge progression follows the authoritative original sequence from the existing Logan opening into Awon and then Medrare, including church/first-spell continuation when the source proves it belongs in this slice; (2) dialogue matches the original source exactly; (3) meaningful blocking/choreography and gating match the original intent after coordinate adaptation; (4) Medrare cannot prematurely fire if Awon or other prerequisites are incomplete; (5) one-shot completion, revisit behavior, leaving/re-entering, and save/load cannot create invalid intermediate story state; (6) any newly required cutscene behavior is implemented generically in shared systems; (7) focused behavioral regressions verify sequence/gating and key choreography semantics; and (8) the built-application Kentridge harness verifies the complete applicable sequence without startup/runtime exceptions.
resolutionSummary: Ported the source-backed Kentridge opening continuation from Logan through Awon and the applicable Medrare beats. Preserved the exact recoverable 22-line Awon payload, distinct post-Awon Medrare sighting/join gates, source-proven join choreography, persistent Medrare party membership, one-time Flame grant, church continuation gating, and save/restore replay suppression. Missing Medrare source text payloads remain intentionally unreconstructed.
